python3 -c '
import sqlite3
import pandas as pd
conn = sqlite3.connect("/workspace/data.sqlite")
for table in pd.read_sql("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type=\"table\";", conn)["name"]:
    print(f"--- {table} ---")
    print(pd.read_sql(f"SELECT * FROM {table}", conn).head())
'

python3 -c '
import sqlite3
conn = sqlite3.connect("/workspace/data.sqlite")
cur = conn.cursor()
tables = [row[0] for row in cur.execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type=\"table\";").fetchall()]
for table in tables:
    print(f"--- {table} ---")
    cur.execute(f"PRAGMA table_info({table});")
    print(cur.fetchall())
    cur.execute(f"SELECT * FROM {table};")
    for row in cur.fetchall(): print(row)
'

python3 -c '
import sqlite3
conn = sqlite3.connect("/workspace/data.sqlite")
cur = conn.cursor()

q1 = """
SELECT
    (SELECT amount FROM financials WHERE measure="Revenue" AND basis="GAAP" AND period_end="2024-10-27" AND months=3) -
    (SELECT midpoint * (1 + range_width/100.0) FROM guidance WHERE measure="Revenue" AND basis="GAAP" AND fiscal_period="Q3FY2025" AND issue_date="2024-08-28")
"""

q2 = """
SELECT
    (SELECT amount FROM financials WHERE measure="Gross profit" AND basis="GAAP" AND period_end="2024-10-27" AND months=3) +
    (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM adjustments WHERE measure="Gross profit" AND period_end="2024-10-27" AND months=3)
"""

q3 = """
SELECT
    ((SELECT amount FROM financials WHERE measure="Gross profit" AND basis="GAAP" AND period_end="2024-10-27" AND months=3) +
    (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM adjustments WHERE measure="Gross profit" AND period_end="2024-10-27" AND months=3)) /
    (SELECT amount FROM financials WHERE measure="Revenue" AND basis="GAAP" AND period_end="2024-10-27" AND months=3) * 100.0
"""

q4 = """
SELECT
    (
        (
            ((SELECT amount FROM financials WHERE measure="Gross profit" AND basis="GAAP" AND period_end="2024-10-27" AND months=3) +
            (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM adjustments WHERE measure="Gross profit" AND period_end="2024-10-27" AND months=3)) /
            (SELECT amount FROM financials WHERE measure="Revenue" AND basis="GAAP" AND period_end="2024-10-27" AND months=3) * 100.0
        )
        -
        (SELECT midpoint + range_width/100.0 FROM guidance WHERE measure="Gross margin" AND basis="non-GAAP" AND fiscal_period="Q3FY2025" AND issue_date="2024-08-28")
    ) * 100.0
"""

print(cur.execute(q1).fetchone()[0])
print(cur.execute(q2).fetchone()[0])
print(cur.execute(q3).fetchone()[0])
print(cur.execute(q4).fetchone()[0])
'
